source_document: <relative path to the infrastructure design markdown file>

backend._type_note: auto = select based on primary provider. Explicit values: gcs, s3, azurerm, ibm-cos, oci, terraform-cloud, http, local (local = no remote state).

config._note: Optional overrides for placeholder values in the backend template. Only set values that differ from the defaults derived from project.name and providers. Example: { "bucket": "my-custom-bucket", "prefix": "custom/path" }

block_storage._template_note: REMOVE THIS ENTRY — replace with actual disks. Each disk resource gets its own entry. Attachment resources must include device_name so the OS device path is deterministic.

_attachment_example.type: <provider disk attachment resource, e.g. google_compute_attached_disk / aws_volume_attachment>

config.device_name: <disk_name — must match the disk resource name. Determines the stable OS path: GCP=/dev/disk/by-id/google-{device_name}, AWS=the device_name argument>
